info.name: certify- Mock IDA
info.description:
Bearer credential issuance against the mock identity system.

Environment ships pointing at a LOCAL deployment. To run the VCI flow against MOSIP's released/collab deployment change these four variables only: authServerUrl, aud, mockIdentitySystemUrl, relayingPartyId. Leave certifyUrl and audUrl as they are - both describe certify itself, which stays local whichever eSignet you point at, and dragging audUrl along with authServerUrl fails every credential request with 400 invalid_proof. Registering your own clients on a hosted deployment additionally needs internalUrl and partnerSecret. See docs/postman-collections/README-mock-identity-dpop.md.

Uses the shared environment "certify-mock env". Run the VCI folder top to bottom; Authorize / OAuthdetails request V2 must run before Send OTP. Its Get Tokens V2 also publishes unbound_access_token, which the DPoP scenarios in "certify- Mock IDA - DPoP" consume.

DEMO KEYS: the RSA private keys in the shared environment are committed to a public repository and must be treated as compromised. They are for the local mock-identity demo only - never register them with an authorization server issuing tokens for anything real.

request.description: Onboard a VCDM 2.0 ldp_vc FarmerCredential config for W3C VC API issuance. Set issuerDid to the DID from GET /.well-known/did.json (same as mosip.certify.data-provider-plugin.did-url).

Issue a signed VCDM 2.0 FarmerCredential via W3C VC API. Requires mosip.certify.vc-api.enabled=true and X-API-Key matching mosip.certify.vc-api.api-keys. Run Add VCDM 2.0 Farmer Config first, and set issuerDid to the onboarded config didUrl. validFrom and validUntil are optional; if omitted, Certify sets validFrom to now and validUntil to validFrom plus the configured expiry duration (default P730D).
Expect 401 ProblemDetails when X-API-Key is omitted.
Expect 401 ProblemDetails when X-API-Key does not match mosip.certify.vc-api.api-keys.
Expect 400 ProblemDetails when X-Credential-Configuration-Id is omitted.
Expect 400 ProblemDetails when X-Credential-Configuration-Id does not match an active onboarded config.
Expect 400 ProblemDetails when credential issuer does not match onboarded config didUrl.
Expect 400 ProblemDetails when credential @context does not match onboarded config contextURLs.
Expect 400 ProblemDetails when credential type does not match onboarded config credentialTypes.
Expect 400 UNKNOWN_OPTION_PROVIDED ProblemDetails when options contains proof hints (challenge, domain, verificationMethod, etc.). These fields are hard-rejected, not ignored.
